description: The price alerts waiting, and those that fired in the last day with the price that fired them. An app sees only the alerts it created. Use before adding one or to find an alert_id to delete. Not for orders waiting for a price (use get_my_open_orders). No inputs. Next: cancel_price_alert.
name: get_my_price_alerts

created_by.description: The agent that created it, or person

current_price.description: On creation: the price it is compared with now, USD per coin

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

direction.description: above: fires when the price is at or above the level; below: at or below

status.description: active (waiting), triggered (fired once, done) or deleted

triggered_price.description: The price that fired it, USD per coin

venue.description: The exchange whose mark is watched; null: the reference price (median of the exchanges' marks; on the sandbox deployment the sandbox's real-market price)
